on_complete.text: James says yes. SE1 4YA, storage unit beside the halal supermarket. He's always in.
Fair warning: James is the best craftsman I know and also the worst person I know. Don't take it personally. He's like that with everyone.

cards.label: {today} — Shoreditch
cards.text: Archie is outside a café full of people in a rush. Archie is looking at the place the way you'd look at a parking fine. One hand stays on his inside pocket.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Buyer's inside. Marcus. Finance. Wants some emotion-type, for his mood, apparently. Don't ask. Just be normal."

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "That's the calc they pulled a knife over."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Correct. Which is why there's two of us. You're a deterrent. Like a scarecrow." He considers you. "No offence."
"Fair enough," he says with a half smile.
cards.speaker: Archie
Marcus
cards.text: Fleece, Patagonia, very clean trainers. Marcus examines the calc with the careful enthusiasm of someone who has recently read about it online. He puts it down. "Eighty."

choices.label: Take the £80
choices.result_text: You nod. Marcus counts out four twenties and slides them across. Archie pockets them before Marcus can change his mind.
